label: Synthetic data generated for development and demonstration. No real customer, account or payment. Second held-out set, written before any system output on it was seen and frozen when its hash is recorded.

cases.title: A ship's IMO number in the payment reference is the one in the listed manager's remarks
cases.note: The counterparty is an unrelated bunker supplier; only the IMO number in the reference ties the payment to the vessel that the listed company's remarks say it manages.

cases.title: The agent named in the payment reference is the person named in the listed company's remarks
cases.note: Neither the counterparty nor its country is linked to the listed company; the agent in the reference is the individual the listed company's remarks name as the one who brokered its oil deal.

cases.title: A Spanish payment reference says the payment is made on behalf of a listed company's alias
cases.note: The reference, in Spanish, says the payment is made for the listed company under its alias; the counterparty name and country say nothing.

cases.title: A Spanish customer note gives a maiden name that is the listed individual's name
cases.note: The structured name and the empty birth date say nothing; the note, in Spanish, gives the listed individual's full name as the customer's maiden name and names the husband the listed remarks name.

cases.title: A German customer note says the account holder is the listed individual's wife
cases.note: No structured field links the customer to the listed individual; the note, in German, names the listed individual as the customer's husband.

cases.title: A French customer note places a branch in the town where the listed exchange office operated
cases.note: The names are different; the note, in French, says the customer, also a money exchange, runs a branch in Albu Kamal, which is the branch location in the listed entry.

cases.title: The counterparty is the person the listed group's remarks name as its founder
cases.note: The counterparty's name is not the listed name; it is the founder and leader the listed group's remarks name (reportedly deceased), so a reviewer must look at it rather than close.

cases.title: Exact name, no birth date on record; a Spanish note records a passport check with a birth date 21 years away
cases.note: The note names the check, a passport number that is not the listed one and a date, so it is documentary; its birth date conflicts with every listed date.

cases.title: The counterparty name equals a listed individual and has no country; the reference documents a landlord and mentions a street whose name looks like a listed group
cases.note: The reference carries a check reference, an ID number and a date, and the counterparty is named; its birth date conflicts with every listed date. The street name is a building in Oxford, not a listed party. Relabelled before any run: the written policy says a counterparty with no usable country cannot be cleared (approved definition counterparty_match@1, and the failing payment rule counterparty_country_valid), so a close would mean ignoring a failing data-quality rule.

cases.title: The counterparty name equals a listed company and has no country; the reference gives a registered company in Leeds
cases.note: The reference carries a check reference, a company number and a date, and names the counterparty with a city that has no link to the listed company. Relabelled before any run: the written policy says a counterparty with no usable country cannot be cleared (approved definition counterparty_match@1, and the failing payment rule counterparty_country_valid), so a close would mean ignoring a failing data-quality rule.

cases.title: Exact name; the note mentions a themed bar named after a weapons maker and gives a documented passport check
cases.note: The name of the bar is a near miss that must not raise risk; the note names the check, a passport number and a date, and its birth date conflicts with every listed date.

cases.title: The customer's name equals a strong alias; a French note records an identity card check with a birth date 18 years away
cases.note: A strong alias match cleared by a note, in French, that carries a check reference, an ID number and a date, with a birth date that conflicts with every listed date.

cases.title: Exact name; a note gives a passport number, a date and a different birth date but names no check
cases.note: The note has a document number and a date but no reference to the check that was made, so it is a claim and cannot clear the match.

cases.title: A payment reference with a check, a company number and a date, but the counterparty is recorded as unknown
cases.note: The reference has all three elements, but the standard also needs a named counterparty for a payment, and the counterparty is recorded as unknown.

cases.title: Exact name; a note gives a check reference and a passport number but only a year of birth and no date
cases.note: The note has a check reference and a document number but no date, so it is a claim and cannot clear the match.

cases.title: Exact name with a conflicting birth date and another nationality; the note says the customer acts for the listed person under a power of attorney
cases.note: The structured fields alone meet the false-positive definition, but the note says the customer holds a power of attorney for a namesake cousin, named with the listed birth date, and signs contracts in that person's name.

cases.title: A name in a long alias, a birth date decades away and another nationality; the listed remarks name the customer as the listed person's father
cases.note: The structured fields alone meet the false-positive definition, but the listed individual's remarks name his father as Akhtar Mohammed (also known as Haji Mira Khan), the customer's full name.

cases.title: Exact name, no birth date on record; an enhanced review note gives a driving licence and a birth date 24 years away
cases.note: The note carries a check reference, a licence number and a date, and its labelled birth date conflicts with the only listed date; the nationality differs and no document matches.

cases.title: The customer's name equals a strong alias, no birth date on record; a compliance note gives an identity card and a birth date 21 years away
cases.note: The note carries a check reference, an identity card number and a date, and its labelled birth date conflicts with the only listed date; the nationality differs and no document matches.
